label: Sci-Fi Horizon
description: Open-sky science-fiction stages — ground-level vistas with sky enough to hold a fleet, weather or a battle overhead. Time-neutral by design; the hour comes from its own dimension.

items.name: arcology-coast
items.text: a crescent coastline dominated by a single arcology pyramid, terraced facades stepping down to a seawall promenade, breakers rolling white against the barrier

items.name: landing-plain
items.text: a fused-glass landing plain scored by decades of touchdown burns, beacon towers in ordered rows to the horizon, blast fences angled against the prevailing wind

items.name: tether-meadow
items.text: rolling grassland pierced by a space-elevator ribbon, the line rising perfectly straight until it thins to nothing, cargo climbers strung along it like slow beads

items.name: flooded-district
items.text: a half-flooded city district gone to reeds, elevated maglev viaducts striding across still water, tower facades reflected between rafts of lilies

items.name: crater-refinery
items.text: an open-pit crater refinery, spiral haul roads descending in terraces toward a molten glow at the floor, gantry cranes silhouetted along the rim

items.name: dune-caravan-route
items.text: a caravan route across engineered dunes, marker pylons half-buried in drift, sand streaming off every crest in one combed direction

items.name: glacier-array
items.text: a dish antenna field set into blue glacier ice, radomes like a string of pearls along a groomed service road, pressure ridges glowing turquoise where the ice thins

items.name: wreck-beach
items.text: a beach where deorbited wreckage washes ashore, barnacled hull ribs rising from the sand like whale bones, tide pools standing in old impact dents

items.name: mesa-farms
items.text: terraced hydro-farms climbing a tabletop mesa, irrigation mist drifting off each shelf, service drones parked in neat chalk-marked squares

items.name: relay-highlands
items.text: highland moor studded with relay masts, warning beacons pulsing in synchronized rhythm, cloud shadows running fast across the heather
